problems_found.title: BuildCues cannot enforce caps on a single oversized word
problems_found.detail: A single Word longer than 32 runes produces 20-rune lines (cap 16); a single Word spanning 8s produces an 8s cue (cap 6s). BuildCues accumulates greedily and never splits WITHIN a word, so a one-word input can violate both §4.10.3 limits. Reachable in practice: EstimateWords splits on whitespace, so a space-less CJK script becomes one giant estimated word. Recorded as skip (CUE-monster-*), not fixed — business-code change forbidden this round

problems_found.title: Plan §7.1 premise on U+2028/2029 is stale (in the good direction)
problems_found.detail: §7.1 says the U+2028/2029 escape test is missing pending F-XSS-01 implementation; empirical check shows encoding/json already escapes both line separators in the projected data block, so a permanent regression test could be added immediately when the gap-tracker next revisits F-XSS-01

problems_found.title: Math.round occurrences in timeline-builder.js are benign but worth knowing
problems_found.detail: Math.round appears at line 92 (counter effect text display — integer display value, correct) and line 191 (seek frame clamping — rounding a fractional seek target, correct); neither is the frame-count path. Documented so future round-vs-ceil audits do not false-positive on them

problems_found.title: ResolveAnchors same_text is asymmetric about candidates
problems_found.detail: When occurrence is out of range, same_text picks the candidate nearest prevWordIndex — with prev=0 and candidates [0,2] this returns index 0 even though occurrence 5 was requested; behavior is per spec (§4.2.4) but means a large occurrence silently degrades instead of missing. Already covered by existing tests; no action needed, noted for audit awareness
